outcome: Impact of pain on daily activities
cohort: 128 women who had given birth and were evaluated within 72 hours postpartum in a public teaching hospital in Sao Paulo city.
finding: Pain was frequent during the postpartum period, with a prevalence of 36.7% during the interview and 54.6% in the previous 24 hours, and significantly affected the mothers' activities.
mod_finding: There was a significant association between presence of pain and type of delivery (cesarean).
